edges.reason: onlyOwner guard compares msg.sender against owner before changing ownership.
withdrawEther is gated by onlyOwner so msg.sender must equal owner.
mintMonster is gated by onlyModerators which tests msg.sender.
AddModerator is gated by onlyOwner which tests msg.sender.
approve calls _canOperate(obj.trainer) which compares msg.sender with the trainer.
_canTransfer requires msg.sender to be owner, approved address or operator.
catchMonster uses msg.sender for addressWhitelist checks and msg.value for payment.
Caller-supplied msg.value is added to gapFactor and compared against the computed price.
getPrice and catchMonster read addressWhitelist[msg.sender] to bypass the catchable flag.
setApprovalForAll stores ownerToOperators[msg.sender][_operator] from caller input.
constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, defining the privileged account.
ChangeOwner rewrites the owner state variable.
owner is read inside the access-control comparison in _canTransfer.
_safeTransferFrom calls the receiver contract after _transfer already moved state, allowing reentrant callbacks.
_safeTransferFrom delegates the actual transfer to _transfer.
_transfer performs external data-contract mapping writes before emitting Transfer.
_burn calls the external data contract to remove the monster mapping, an external interaction during state change.
_safeTransferFrom reads the monster object from the external data contract before transferring.
transferFrom loads MonsterObjAcc via data.getMonsterObj.
transfer loads MonsterObjAcc via data.getMonsterObj.
approve loads MonsterObjAcc via data.getMonsterObj.
getApproved loads MonsterObjAcc via data.getMonsterObj.
_burn loads MonsterObjAcc via data.getMonsterObj.
catchMonster reads the class record from the external data contract.
getPrice reads the class record from the external data contract.
renameMonster loads MonsterObjAcc via data.getMonsterObj.
getMonsterCurrentStats loads MonsterObjAcc via data.getMonsterObj.
getMonsterCP loads MonsterObjAcc via data.getMonsterObj.
_canTransfer queries battle.isOnBattle and trade.isOnTrading.
approve reverts when battle.isOnBattle or trade.isOnTrading returns true.
_burn reverts when battle.isOnBattle or trade.isOnTrading returns true.
withdrawEther performs _sendTo.transfer(_amount).
_sendTo is the destination of the ether transfer.
_amount is the value transferred out of the contract.
getPrice computes price += class.price*(class.total-1)/priceIncreasingRatio with unchecked math.
catchMonster recomputes the same unchecked multiplication/division price formula.
catchMonster evaluates msg.value + gapFactor < price, an unchecked addition.
AddModerator executes totalModerators += 1 on a uint16.
RemoveModerator executes totalModerators -= 1 on a uint16.
priceIncreasingRatio is the divisor of the dynamic price formula.
gapFactor is added to msg.value in the payment comparison.
totalModerators is the storage slot mutated by the counter arithmetic.
seed is passed into getRandom as entropy input.
The getRandom result is assigned back to the seed state variable.
catchMonster seeds randomness with block.number-1 and the new objId.
mintMonster calls getRandom to derive base stats.
catchMonster calls addMonsterObj and addElementToArrayType on the data contract.
mintMonster calls addMonsterObj and addElementToArrayType on the data contract.
approve writes idToApprovals[_tokenId] = _approved.
getApproved reads idToApprovals[_tokenId].
_clearApproval deletes the idToApprovals entry.
setApprovalForAll writes ownerToOperators[msg.sender][_operator].
_canOperate reads ownerToOperators[_tokenOwner][msg.sender].
_canTransfer reads ownerToOperators as part of the operator authorization check.
_transfer clears the token approval before moving the monster.
_burn clears the token approval before removing the monster.
triggerTransferEvent clears approval before emitting Transfer.
transferFrom calls _transfer to move the monster.
transfer calls _transfer to move the monster.
burnMonster calls _burn.
transferFrom validates the caller through _canTransfer.
transfer validates the caller through _canTransfer.
_safeTransferFrom validates the caller through _canTransfer.
setOperationContracts writes dataContract, the external dependency address.
setOperationContracts writes battleContract.
setOperationContracts writes tradeContract.

setTokenURI writes idToUri through _setTokenUri.

getLevel binary-searches the levelExps table.
mintMonster assigns the getRandom result to the seed.
catchMonster assigns the getRandom result to the seed.

normalization_plan.reason: _sendTo is only used as the destination of the ether transfer in withdrawEther.
_amount is only used as the transferred value in withdrawEther.
_newOwner is only used to overwrite owner in ChangeOwner.
_newModerator is only used inside AddModerator.
_isMaintaining is only used inside UpdateMaintaining.
_dataContract is only consumed by setOperationContracts.
_battleContract is only consumed by setOperationContracts.
_tradeContract is only consumed by setOperationContracts.
_from is only validated against the trainer in the transfer entry points.
_to is only used as the transfer destination in the transfer entry points.
_tokenId is the lookup key for the monster in the transfer entry points.
_data is only forwarded to onERC721Received inside _safeTransferFrom.
_approved is only written into idToApprovals by approve.
_operator is only written into ownerToOperators by setApprovalForAll.
_owner is only used to index ownerToOperators in isApprovedForAll.
_index is only passed to the data contract in tokenOfOwnerByIndex.
_player only becomes the trainer inside catchMonster.
_classId only selects the class and price inside catchMonster.
_name is only written to the new monster inside catchMonster.
_block is only used as the blockhash argument in getRandom.
_seed is only hashed inside getRandom.
_count is only hashed inside getRandom.
exp is only compared against levelExps in getLevel.
_monsterId is only used to look up stats in the stat getters.
_objId is only used to select the monster in renameMonster.
name is only written to the monster object in renameMonster.
_ratio is only assigned to priceIncreasingRatio.
_gapFactor is only assigned to gapFactor.
_status is only written into classWhitelist.
_smartcontract is only written into addressWhitelist.
_uri is only written into idToUri.
addr is only used by the isContract check that gates the receiver callback in _safeTransferFrom.
The local MonsterObjAcc exists only to hold the external getMonsterObj result.
The local price exists only to hold the unchecked price formula result.
The local MonsterClassAcc exists only to hold the external getMonsterClass result.
The local objId exists only to carry the external addMonsterObj result into further data writes.
